purpose: Determine whether already-produced, row-independent single-recipe predictions can satisfy the V5 raw-gain requirement without reusing the signed or many-arm V4 meta stacks.

candidate_formula.R: a nonnegative convex mixture of at most three listed single-recipe prediction vectors
candidate_formula.weights: multiples of 0.025, nonnegative, sum exactly to one
candidate_formula.selection_objective: maximize the minimum full-score gain over 2022 and 2023 against the strongest of exact C, honest R identity, and honest R grid in each year

decision.if_below: close tuning of the existing prediction library and move to a new data/model structure
decision.if_above: freeze the exact components and weights before any 2024 confirmation
